h:
简单实用的 Krea 2 工作流程，专为使用 LoRA 快速灵活地生成图像而设计。

它最有用的功能是自动元数据保存。生成的图像包括必要的生成信息，让 CivitAI 自动检测资源图像中使用的，包括基础模型和 LoRA。这使得上传大量图像的速度大大加快，并且无需手动一张一张地添加资源。

工作流程使一切保持干净且易于使用，内置 LoRA 堆栈可快速启用、禁用和调整多种风格的 LoRA，同时还有一个长度更宽的单独字符 LoRA 加载器，以便您在切换时可以看到它们的完整名称及其纪元号。

要求：

此工作流程需要ComfyUI_SaveImageWithMetaDataUniversal用于自动保存元数据的自定义节点。

打开你的ComfyUI/自定义节点文件夹中，在地址栏中输入CMD并运行：

git 克隆 https://github.com/xxmjskxx/ComfyUI_SaveImageWithMetaDataUniversal

安装后，重新启动 ComfyUI 并加载工作流程。

o.en:
A simple and practical Krea 2 workflow designed for fast and flexible image generation with LoRAs.

Its most useful features isautomatic metadata saving. Generated images include the necessary generation information,allowing CivitAI to automatically detect the resourcesused in the image, including the base model and LoRAs. This makes uploading large numbers of images much faster and eliminates the need to manually add resources one by one.

The workflow keeps everything clean and easy to use, with a built-in LoRA stack for quickly enabling, disabling, and adjusting multiple style LoRAs, alongside a separate character LoRA loader with wider length so you could see the entire name of them and their epoch number when switching.

Requirement :

This workflow requires theComfyUI_SaveImageWithMetaDataUniversalcustom node for automatic metadata saving.

Open yourComfyUI/custom_nodesfolder, type CMD in the address bar and run:

git clone https://github.com/xxmjskxx/ComfyUI_SaveImageWithMetaDataUniversal

After installation, restart ComfyUI and load the workflow.
